import numpy as np, itertools
s=np.sqrt(eps); one=np.ones_like(eps)
base=np.column_stack([one,T**2,np.log(T),1/T,s/T,eps])
c0=np.linalg.lstsq(base,sigma,rcond=None)[0]; r0=sigma-base@c0
feats={}
for i,j,k in itertools.product([0,0.5,1,1.5,2,3],[-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2,3],[0,1]):
    v=eps**i*T**j*(np.log(T) if k else 1)
    feats[f"e^{i} T^{j} logT^{k}"]=v
    feats[f"e^{i} T^{j} logT^{k} *s/T"]=v*s/T
best=[]
for k,v in feats.items():
    if np.std(v)<1e-12: continue
    X=np.column_stack([base,v]); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
    best.append((np.mean((sigma-X@c)**2)/np.var(sigma),k))
best.sort()
print(best[:12])
